name: 好友房｜注册账号次日登录留存率
definition: 以注册日D的friend_ods.user_info去重user_id为人群，D+1在friend_ods.app_login_log有登录记录的同账号人数除以注册账号数。按注册日展示，产品、渠道和平台按注册人群对应的主档字段筛选，属性维度取当前主档值，不回溯历史变更，回访不强制同渠道或平台。只计算已完整结束的回访日；未成熟返回NULL，无注册人群不补0。输出0—1比例。近七日大屏及上月日均的日期轴补零另作展示，不改变本指标人群和D+1观察点。
sql:
WITH cohort AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT DATE(reg_date) AS dt,user_id FROM friend_ods.user_info
 WHERE reg_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND reg_date<CURRENT_DATE()
),visits AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT DATE(login_date) AS dt,user_id FROM friend_ods.app_login_log
 WHERE login_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND login_date<CURRENT_DATE()
)
SELECT c.dt,CASE WHEN DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()
 THEN COUNT(DISTINCT v.user_id)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id),0) ELSE NULL END AS metric_value
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN visits v ON v.user_id=c.user_id AND v.dt=DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY c.dt;

name: 好友房｜设备七日留存率
definition: 以friend_ods.cell_mac_info.first_open_date当日首次激活的去重mac为新增设备人群，分子为这些设备在首次激活日加6日有friend_ods.app_login_log登录记录的去重mac数，分母为该首次激活日的新增设备去重mac数。与运营总表对齐时，日期为回访日，首次激活日=报表日期减6日；按首次激活日展示须明确平移日期轴。只计算已完整结束的回访日；返回0—1比例，展示乘100%。产品pid、渠道agent_id筛选取首次激活记录；登录仅按mac匹配，不额外限定回访渠道。不能替代为活跃设备回访率、账号留存、金币房留存或连续7日登录率。分母无设备时为NULL，跨日和跨维度汇总须从明细重新去重。
sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE(first_open_date) AS cohort_date, mac
  FROM friend_ods.cell_mac_info
  WHERE first_open_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 36 DAY)
    AND first_open_date < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY)
), visits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE(login_date) AS visit_date, mac
  FROM friend_ods.app_login_log
  WHERE login_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    AND login_date < CURRENT_DATE()
)
SELECT DATE_ADD(c.cohort_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY) AS dt,
       c.cohort_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.mac) AS new_device_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.mac) AS retained_device_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT v.mac) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.mac), 0) AS metric_value
FROM cohort c
LEFT JOIN visits v ON v.mac = c.mac
  AND v.visit_date = DATE_ADD(c.cohort_date, INTERVAL 6 DAY)
GROUP BY c.cohort_date;

sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(log_date) dt,SUM(end_num-begin_num) metric_value FROM friend_ods.package_log WHERE log_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND log_date<CURRENT_DATE() AND (prop_id=300 AND end_num>begin_num AND (order_no IS NULL OR TRIM(order_no)='') AND type IN (115,123,128)) GROUP BY DATE(log_date)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜七日交叉钻石总产出
definition: `package_log` 中 `prop_id=300` 且 `end_num>begin_num` 的余额差 `end_num-begin_num` 求和。 不限制 `type`；活动发放和房卡兑换明细仍包含在总产出内。 period_type区分最近七日与上月日均；展示补零不代表底表完整。 单位：钻石。
sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(log_date) dt,SUM(end_num-begin_num) metric_value FROM friend_ods.package_log WHERE log_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND log_date<CURRENT_DATE() AND (prop_id=300 AND end_num>begin_num) GROUP BY DATE(log_date)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜七日交叉贵族充值金额
definition: 成功订单 `item_id` 为111、112、254、256的 `infull_amount/100` 求和。 `friend_ods.pook_infull`，`infull_state=1`。 period_type区分最近七日与上月日均；展示补零不代表底表完整。 单位：元。
sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(success_date) dt,SUM(infull_amount)/100.0 metric_value FROM friend_ods.pook_infull WHERE success_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND success_date<CURRENT_DATE() AND (infull_state=1 AND item_id IN (111,112,254,256)) GROUP BY DATE(success_date)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜七日交叉玩家充值金额
definition: 成功充值金额 − 代理充值金额。 与总充值使用同日订单范围。 period_type区分最近七日与上月日均；展示补零不代表底表完整。 单位：元。
sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(success_date) dt,(SUM(infull_amount)-SUM(CASE WHEN item_id IN (1,21,22,23,24,25,26,31,32,1000,10002,10003,10004) THEN infull_amount ELSE 0 END))/100.0 metric_value FROM friend_ods.pook_infull WHERE success_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND success_date<CURRENT_DATE() AND (infull_state=1) GROUP BY DATE(success_date)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜七日交叉代理充值金额
definition: 成功订单中 `item_id` 属于代理白名单时，对 `infull_amount/100` 求和。 白名单1、21、22、23、24、25、26、31、32、1000、10002、10003、10004。 period_type区分最近七日与上月日均；展示补零不代表底表完整。 单位：元。
sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(success_date) dt,SUM(infull_amount)/100.0 metric_value FROM friend_ods.pook_infull WHERE success_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND success_date<CURRENT_DATE() AND (infull_state=1 AND item_id IN (1,21,22,23,24,25,26,31,32,1000,10002,10003,10004)) GROUP BY DATE(success_date)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜七日交叉成功充值金额
definition: `infull_state=1` 订单 `SUM(infull_amount)/100`。 `friend_ods.pook_infull.success_date`；单位元。 period_type区分最近七日与上月日均；展示补零不代表底表完整。 单位：元。
sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(success_date) dt,SUM(infull_amount)/100.0 metric_value FROM friend_ods.pook_infull WHERE success_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND success_date<CURRENT_DATE() AND (infull_state=1) GROUP BY DATE(success_date)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜七日交叉开桌数
definition: `friend_ods.friend_game_log` 按日统计 `COUNT(DISTINCT friend_game_num)`。 牌桌数，不等同于开房耗卡牌局数。 period_type区分最近七日与上月日均；展示补零不代表底表完整。 单位：桌。
sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(log_time) dt,COUNT(DISTINCT friend_game_num) metric_value FROM friend_ods.friend_game_log WHERE log_time>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND log_time<CURRENT_DATE() AND (1=1) GROUP BY DATE(log_time)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜七日交叉游戏账号数
definition: `friend_ods.comm_game_log` 按日 `COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)`。 该数据集未另加 `game_time>0` 条件。 period_type区分最近七日与上月日均；展示补零不代表底表完整。 单位：个。
sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(log_time) dt,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM friend_ods.comm_game_log WHERE log_time>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND log_time<CURRENT_DATE() AND (1=1) GROUP BY DATE(log_time)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜七日交叉日活跃账号数
definition: `friend_ods.app_login_log` 按日 `COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)`。 按登录日。 period_type区分最近七日与上月日均；展示补零不代表底表完整。 单位：个。
sql: WITH digits AS (SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 n UNION ALL SELECT 2 n UNION ALL SELECT 3 n UNION ALL SELECT 4 n UNION ALL SELECT 5 n UNION ALL SELECT 6 n UNION ALL SELECT 7 n UNION ALL SELECT 8 n UNION ALL SELECT 9 n),dates AS (SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY) dt FROM digits a CROSS JOIN digits b WHERE DATE_ADD(DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),INTERVAL (a.n*10+b.n) DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),daily AS (SELECT DATE(login_date) dt,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM friend_ods.app_login_log WHERE login_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND login_date<CURRENT_DATE() AND (1=1) GROUP BY DATE(login_date)),filled AS (SELECT d.dt,COALESCE(f.metric_value,0) metric_value FROM dates d LEFT JOIN daily f ON f.dt=d.dt) SELECT dt,'最近七日' period_type,metric_value FROM filled WHERE dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 7 DAY) UNION ALL SELECT NULL,'上月日均',AVG(metric_value) FROM filled WHERE dt<DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(),'%Y-%m-01');

name: 好友房｜注册新增账号数
definition: 按friend_ods.user_info.reg_date归日，对user_id去重统计注册新增账号。以账号主档所记录的注册时间识别，和首次激活设备、首次进入玩法分别统计；跨日期、产品和渠道从明细重新去重。属性维度取当前主档字段值，不回溯历史变更。近七日窗口、上月日均和日期轴补零属于展示计算，补零不代表源数据完整。单位：账号。
sql:
SELECT DATE(reg_date) AS dt,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.user_info
WHERE reg_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND reg_date<CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY DATE(reg_date);

name: 金币房｜金币余额分位数
definition: 对用户日最后一条登录余额 `money` 计算近似第十、第二十五、第五十、第七十、八十五、九十五、九十九百分位。 使用 `approx_percentile`；产品总体从映射渠道用户明细重新计算，全局总体从全部用户明细重新计算。分位数不得跨渠道直接相加或取平均。 单位：金币。
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT DATE(login_date) dt,user_id,money,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DATE(login_date),user_id ORDER BY login_date DESC,id DESC) rn FROM gold_ods.app_login_log WHERE login_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND login_date < CURRENT_DATE()),snapshot AS (SELECT dt,user_id,money FROM ranked WHERE rn=1) SELECT dt,0.1 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.1) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.25 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.25) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.5 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.5) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.7 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.7) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.85 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.85) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.95 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.95) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt UNION ALL SELECT dt,0.99 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(money,0.99) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt;

name: 金币房｜每日人均金币
definition: 每日金币总存量 ÷ 当日有余额快照的去重账号数。 以用户日余额快照为分母。 单位：金币/有余额账号。
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT DATE(login_date) dt,user_id,money,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DATE(login_date),user_id ORDER BY login_date DESC,id DESC) rn FROM gold_ods.app_login_log WHERE login_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND login_date < CURRENT_DATE()),snapshot AS (SELECT dt,user_id,money FROM ranked WHERE rn=1) SELECT dt,SUM(money)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id),0) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt;

name: 金币房｜每日金币总存量
definition: 每名用户每天取最后一条登录记录的 `money`，对用户日余额求和。 `gold_ods.app_login_log`；按用户、自然日排序，取最后一条登录记录。 单位：金币。
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT DATE(login_date) dt,user_id,money,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY DATE(login_date),user_id ORDER BY login_date DESC,id DESC) rn FROM gold_ods.app_login_log WHERE login_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND login_date < CURRENT_DATE()),snapshot AS (SELECT dt,user_id,money FROM ranked WHERE rn=1) SELECT dt,SUM(money) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt;

name: 金币房｜比赛第七日留存率
definition: 首次参与该赛事 cohort 中，在首参与日加6日仍有该赛事有效对局的账号数 ÷ cohort账号数。 与次日留存相同赛事和 cohort；宽表保留0至1比例，长表按SQL格式输出百分数。 单位：0—1比例。
sql: WITH first_play AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,game_id,DATE(first_login_time) dt FROM gold_ods.user_game_info WHERE first_login_time>='2026-01-01' AND first_login_time<CURRENT_DATE() AND game_id IN (2070,2012)) SELECT c.dt,c.game_id,COUNT(DISTINCT g.user_id)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id),0) metric_value FROM first_play c LEFT JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.game_id=c.game_id AND g.game_time>0 AND DATE(g.log_time)=DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL 6 DAY) WHERE DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL 6 DAY)<CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY c.dt,c.game_id;

name: 金币房｜比赛第三日留存率
definition: 首次参与该赛事 cohort 中，在首参与日加2日仍有该赛事有效对局的账号数 ÷ cohort账号数。 与次日留存相同赛事和 cohort；全局层按账号明细重新计算。 单位：0—1比例。
sql: WITH first_play AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,game_id,DATE(first_login_time) dt FROM gold_ods.user_game_info WHERE first_login_time>='2026-01-01' AND first_login_time<CURRENT_DATE() AND game_id IN (2070,2012)) SELECT c.dt,c.game_id,COUNT(DISTINCT g.user_id)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id),0) metric_value FROM first_play c LEFT JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.game_id=c.game_id AND g.game_time>0 AND DATE(g.log_time)=DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL 2 DAY) WHERE DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL 2 DAY)<CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY c.dt,c.game_id;

name: 金币房｜比赛次日留存率
definition: 首次参与该赛事 cohort 中，在首参与日加1日仍有该赛事有效对局的账号数 ÷ cohort账号数。 `user_game_info.first_login_time` 识别首参与；同一 `game_id`，`comm_game_log.game_time>0`。 单位：0—1比例。
sql: WITH first_play AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,game_id,DATE(first_login_time) dt FROM gold_ods.user_game_info WHERE first_login_time>='2026-01-01' AND first_login_time<CURRENT_DATE() AND game_id IN (2070,2012)) SELECT c.dt,c.game_id,COUNT(DISTINCT g.user_id)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id),0) metric_value FROM first_play c LEFT JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.game_id=c.game_id AND g.game_time>0 AND DATE(g.log_time)=DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY)<CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY c.dt,c.game_id;

name: 金币房｜比赛首次参与账号数
definition: `user_game_info.first_login_time` 落在统计日的账号去重数。 `gold_ods.user_game_info`；赛事玩法首次参与时间从2026年1月1日起。 单位：个。
sql: WITH first_play AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,game_id,DATE(first_login_time) dt FROM gold_ods.user_game_info WHERE first_login_time>='2026-01-01' AND first_login_time<CURRENT_DATE() AND game_id IN (2070,2012)) SELECT dt,game_id,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM first_play GROUP BY dt,game_id;

name: 金币房｜比赛当日付费账号数
definition: 当日参与比赛且当日有成功充值到账的账号去重数。 `gold_ods.infull_order`，`order_status=1`；按同一账号、自然日和比赛玩法聚合。 单位：个。
sql: SELECT DATE(g.log_time) dt,g.game_id,COUNT(DISTINCT g.user_id) metric_value FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log g JOIN gold_ods.infull_order o ON o.user_id=g.user_id AND DATE(o.success_date)=DATE(g.log_time) AND o.order_status=1 WHERE g.log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND g.log_time < CURRENT_DATE() AND g.game_time>0 AND g.game_id IN (2070,2012) GROUP BY DATE(g.log_time),g.game_id;

name: 金币房｜比赛人均对局次数
definition: 比赛玩家对局日志行数 ÷ 比赛对局账号数。 源 SQL 的总局数是玩家对局日志行数，不是去重 `game_num`。 单位：玩家参局人次/账号。
sql: SELECT DATE(log_time) dt,game_id,COUNT(*)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id),0) metric_value FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE() AND game_time>0 AND game_id IN (2070,2012) GROUP BY DATE(log_time),game_id;

name: 金币房｜比赛人均游戏时长
definition: 比赛玩法 `game_time` 总秒数 ÷ 比赛对局账号数，再换算为分钟。 有效对局；按日期、玩法、产品、渠道。 单位：分钟/账号。
sql: SELECT DATE(log_time) dt,game_id,SUM(game_time)/60.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id),0) metric_value FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE() AND game_time>0 AND game_id IN (2070,2012) GROUP BY DATE(log_time),game_id;

name: 金币房｜比赛对局账号数
definition: 比赛玩法当日有有效对局的 `user_id` 去重数。 `gold_ods.comm_game_log`，`game_time>0`；按日期、玩法、产品、渠道。 单位：个。
sql: SELECT DATE(log_time) dt,game_id,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE() AND game_time>0 AND game_id IN (2070,2012) GROUP BY DATE(log_time),game_id;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日金币存量分位数
definition: 对观察日账号最后一条 `end_num` 计算近似第十五、第三十五、第五十五、第七十五、第九十五百分位。 使用源 SQL 的 `approx_percentile`；产品全局及总全局按账号明细重新计算。 单位：金币。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),ranked AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,m.end_num,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id ORDER BY m.id DESC) rn FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.user_money_log m ON m.user_id=c.user_id AND m.prop_id=1 AND m.log_date>=c.observed_dt AND m.log_date<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY)),snapshot AS (SELECT dt,observation_day,user_id,end_num FROM ranked WHERE rn=1) SELECT dt,observation_day,0.15 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.15) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day UNION ALL SELECT dt,observation_day,0.35 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.35) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day UNION ALL SELECT dt,observation_day,0.55 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.55) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day UNION ALL SELECT dt,observation_day,0.75 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.75) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day UNION ALL SELECT dt,observation_day,0.95 percentile,APPROX_PERCENTILE(end_num,0.95) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日人均金币存量
definition: 观察日金币存量总量 ÷ 有最后一条金币存量快照的新增账号数。 不是除以注册 cohort 人数或登录人数。 单位：金币/有存量账号。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),ranked AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,m.end_num,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id ORDER BY m.id DESC) rn FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.user_money_log m ON m.user_id=c.user_id AND m.prop_id=1 AND m.log_date>=c.observed_dt AND m.log_date<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY)),snapshot AS (SELECT dt,observation_day,user_id,end_num FROM ranked WHERE rn=1) SELECT dt,observation_day,SUM(end_num)*1.0/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id),0) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日金币存量总量
definition: 每个 cohort 账号取观察日 `gold_ods.user_money_log` 中 `prop_id=1` 的最后一条流水 `end_num`，再求和。 同一账号、自然日按 `id` 降序取末条；有存量记录的账号进入存量计算。 单位：金币。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),ranked AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,m.end_num,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id ORDER BY m.id DESC) rn FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.user_money_log m ON m.user_id=c.user_id AND m.prop_id=1 AND m.log_date>=c.observed_dt AND m.log_date<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY)),snapshot AS (SELECT dt,observation_day,user_id,end_num FROM ranked WHERE rn=1) SELECT dt,observation_day,SUM(end_num) metric_value FROM snapshot GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日登录人数
definition: D2、D3 cohort 中，在注册日加1日或加2日有 `app_login_log` 记录的 `user_id` 去重数。 `gold_daily_nu_retention_d2_inventory.sql`、`gold_daily_nu_retention_d3_inventory.sql`；不与各自注册新增账号数或有金币流水账号数混用。 单位：个。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()) SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_id) metric_value FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.app_login_log l ON l.user_id=c.user_id AND l.login_date>=c.observed_dt AND l.login_date<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE c.observation_day IN (2,3) GROUP BY c.dt,c.observation_day;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日付费率
definition: 观察日有成功充值的新增账号数 ÷ 观察日对局账号数。 `gold_ods.infull_order` 成功订单按观察日归属；分母为对局账号，不是登录人数或注册 cohort 总人数。 单位：0—1比例。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),pay AS (SELECT DISTINCT DATE(success_date) dt,user_id FROM gold_ods.infull_order WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND order_status=1),counts AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) paid,COUNT(DISTINCT g.user_id) players FROM cohort_observation c LEFT JOIN pay p ON p.user_id=c.user_id AND p.dt=c.observed_dt LEFT JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.log_time>=c.observed_dt AND g.log_time<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND g.game_time>0 GROUP BY c.dt,c.observation_day) SELECT dt,observation_day,paid*1.0/NULLIF(players,0) metric_value FROM counts;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日破产率
definition: 有至少一条 `begin_money + result_money - num_8 = 0` 对局记录的账号数 ÷ 观察日对局账号数。 按账号判定，严格等于零；不同于新用户详情的低于1000金币局级破产率。 单位：0—1比例。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),per_user AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,SUM(g.game_time) game_seconds,MAX(CASE WHEN g.result_money>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won,MAX(CASE WHEN g.begin_money+g.result_money-g.num_8=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) broke FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.log_time>=c.observed_dt AND g.log_time<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND g.game_time>0 GROUP BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id) SELECT dt,observation_day,AVG(broke*1.0) metric_value FROM per_user GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日胜率
definition: 有至少一条 `result_money>0` 对局记录的账号数 ÷ 观察日对局账号数。 D1、D2、D3各自的有效对局；按账号判定，平局不算胜利。 单位：0—1比例。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),per_user AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,SUM(g.game_time) game_seconds,MAX(CASE WHEN g.result_money>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won,MAX(CASE WHEN g.begin_money+g.result_money-g.num_8=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) broke FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.log_time>=c.observed_dt AND g.log_time<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND g.game_time>0 GROUP BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id) SELECT dt,observation_day,AVG(won*1.0) metric_value FROM per_user GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日人均游戏时长
definition: 先按账号汇总观察日 `game_time`，再对有有效对局的新增账号取平均并换算为分钟。 分母为观察日对局账号数，不是全部注册账号数。 单位：分钟/对局账号。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),per_user AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,SUM(g.game_time) game_seconds,MAX(CASE WHEN g.result_money>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won,MAX(CASE WHEN g.begin_money+g.result_money-g.num_8=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) broke FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.log_time>=c.observed_dt AND g.log_time<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND g.game_time>0 GROUP BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id) SELECT dt,observation_day,AVG(game_seconds)/60.0 metric_value FROM per_user GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号观察日对局人数
definition: 在注册当日、注册日加1日或加2日的新增 cohort 中，当天存在有效对局的账号去重数。 D1、D2、D3分别对应上述观察日；`gold_ods.comm_game_log`，`game_time>0`。 单位：个。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 32 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()),offsets AS (SELECT 0 lag_days,1 observation_day UNION ALL SELECT 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,3),cohort_observation AS (SELECT c.user_id,c.dt,o.lag_days,o.observation_day,DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY) observed_dt FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN offsets o WHERE c.dt>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL (30+o.lag_days) DAY) AND DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL o.lag_days DAY)<CURRENT_DATE()),per_user AS (SELECT c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id,SUM(g.game_time) game_seconds,MAX(CASE WHEN g.result_money>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won,MAX(CASE WHEN g.begin_money+g.result_money-g.num_8=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) broke FROM cohort_observation c JOIN gold_ods.comm_game_log g ON g.user_id=c.user_id AND g.log_time>=c.observed_dt AND g.log_time<DATE_ADD(c.observed_dt,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND g.game_time>0 GROUP BY c.dt,c.observation_day,c.user_id) SELECT dt,observation_day,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM per_user GROUP BY dt,observation_day;

name: 金币房｜分玩法新增账号生命周期累计人均充值金额
definition: 分玩法 cohort 限定为 `first_login_time` 与账号注册日同日；按成功订单金额累计并除以当日该玩法首次参与账号数。 同一注册日、玩法、产品及渠道；产品和全局人数及金额按源明细重新汇总。 window_days为包含注册当日的累计观察天数；近期cohort保留截至昨天已到账金额，不宣称完整观察窗。 单位：元/注册账号。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id,DATE(u.reg_date) dt,g.game_id FROM gold_ods.user_info u JOIN gold_ods.user_game_info g ON g.user_id=u.user_id AND DATE(g.first_login_time)=DATE(u.reg_date) WHERE u.reg_date>='2026-01-01' AND u.reg_date<CURRENT_DATE()),windows AS (SELECT 1 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 2 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 3 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 4 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 5 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 6 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 7 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 14 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 30 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 60 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 90 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 180 window_days) SELECT c.dt,c.game_id,w.window_days,SUM(COALESCE(o.order_amount,0))/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id),0) metric_value FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN windows w LEFT JOIN gold_ods.infull_order o ON o.user_id=c.user_id AND o.order_status=1 AND o.success_date>=c.dt AND o.success_date<DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL w.window_days DAY) AND o.success_date<CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY c.dt,c.game_id,w.window_days;

name: 金币房｜注册新增账号生命周期累计人均充值金额
definition: 成功订单金额在注册日及其后按观察窗累计，分别除以当日注册新增账号数；SQL字段覆盖注册当日及累计二、三、四、五、六、七、十四、三十、六十、九十、一百八十日。累计二日含注册当日和次日；其余按 SQL 中的日期偏移边界。 `gold_ods.infull_order`，`order_status=1`，成功时间不早于注册日；无充值账号按零收入计入 cohort 分母。 window_days为包含注册当日的累计观察天数；近期cohort保留截至昨天已到账金额，不宣称完整观察窗。 单位：元/注册账号。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date>='2026-01-01' AND reg_date<CURRENT_DATE()),windows AS (SELECT 1 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 2 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 3 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 4 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 5 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 6 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 7 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 14 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 30 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 60 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 90 window_days UNION ALL SELECT 180 window_days) SELECT c.dt,w.window_days,SUM(COALESCE(o.order_amount,0))/NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id),0) metric_value FROM cohort c CROSS JOIN windows w LEFT JOIN gold_ods.infull_order o ON o.user_id=c.user_id AND o.order_status=1 AND o.success_date>=c.dt AND o.success_date<DATE_ADD(c.dt,INTERVAL w.window_days DAY) AND o.success_date<CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY c.dt,w.window_days;

name: 金币房｜分玩法生命周期新增账号数
definition: 注册日与 `user_game_info.first_login_time` 的自然日相同，按账号和 `game_id` 识别首次进入该玩法的新增 cohort。 `gold_ods.user_game_info` 与 `gold_ods.user_info`；同一玩法、注册日分别去重。 单位：个。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id,DATE(u.reg_date) dt,g.game_id FROM gold_ods.user_info u JOIN gold_ods.user_game_info g ON g.user_id=u.user_id AND DATE(g.first_login_time)=DATE(u.reg_date) WHERE u.reg_date>='2026-01-01' AND u.reg_date<CURRENT_DATE()) SELECT dt,game_id,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM cohort GROUP BY dt,game_id;

name: 金币房｜生命周期注册新增账号数
definition: 按 `user_info.reg_date` 归属注册日，按 `COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)` 计 cohort。 `gold_ods.user_info`；渠道使用注册账号 `agent_id`。 单位：个。
sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id,DATE(reg_date) dt FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date>='2026-01-01' AND reg_date<CURRENT_DATE()) SELECT dt,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM cohort GROUP BY dt;

name: 金币房｜系统总盈亏
definition: 桌费 − 真人用户总盈亏。 这是经济大盘当前定义；不把机器人总盈亏加进公式。游戏侧来源缺失时为 `NULL`，不以零替代。 单位：金币。
sql: WITH per_day AS (SELECT DATE(log_time) dt,SUM(num_8) fee,SUM(result_money) pnl FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE() AND user_id NOT BETWEEN 2614636 AND 2615635 GROUP BY DATE(log_time)) SELECT dt,fee-pnl metric_value FROM per_day;
dependencies: ["金币房｜真人用户总盈亏", "金币房｜桌费"]

name: 金币房｜混服补分
definition: 真人用户总盈亏 + 机器人总盈亏。 仅全局总行输出，作为单独指标，不并入系统总盈亏公式。 单位：金币。
sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT DATE(log_time) AS dt, SUM(result_money) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log
WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (user_id NOT BETWEEN 2614636 AND 2615635)
GROUP BY DATE(log_time)),b AS (SELECT DATE(log_time) AS dt, SUM(result_money) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log
WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (user_id BETWEEN 2614636 AND 2615635)
GROUP BY DATE(log_time)) SELECT a.dt,a.metric_value + b.metric_value metric_value FROM a JOIN b ON a.dt=b.dt;
dependencies: ["金币房｜真人用户总盈亏", "金币房｜机器人总盈亏"]

name: 金币房｜金币总产出
definition: 付费金币产出 + 活动金币产出 + 免费金币产出。 各组成项必须使用同一日期、渠道和产品范围。 单位：金币。
sql:
WITH parts AS (SELECT dt,metric_value FROM (WITH flow AS (SELECT DATE(log_date) dt,prop_num n FROM gold_ods.user_money_log WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND prop_id=1 AND prop_num>0 AND (type IN (102,125,126,129,134,139,143,149,157,235,236,242,997,998,1000,1005,449,451,452,453) OR (type=447 AND prop_num<>1500)) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(log_date),prop_num FROM gold_ods.prop_log WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND prop_id=1 AND data_type=102 AND prop_num>0) SELECT dt,SUM(n) metric_value FROM flow GROUP BY dt) x UNION ALL SELECT dt,metric_value FROM (SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.user_money_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=1 AND prop_num>0 AND type NOT IN (1,6,10,102,125,126,129,134,139,143,149,157,223,235,236,242,997,998,1000,1005,449,451,452,453,2411,2412,454,455,1132,1133,1135,1136) AND type NOT BETWEEN 1100 AND 1127 AND (type<>447 OR prop_num=1500))
GROUP BY DATE(log_date)) x UNION ALL SELECT dt,metric_value FROM (SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.user_money_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=1 AND prop_num>0 AND type IN (454,455,2411,2412,1132,1133,1135,1136))

definition: 按gold_ods.infull_order.success_date归日，限定order_status=1，以COUNT(*)统计成功充值订单记录数。原点券充值订单数通过product_name LIKE '%点券%'筛选；商品、充值渠道、客户端及账号均在同一成功订单范围内限定。该指标不是去重付费账号数，也不包括金币到账日志所称的交易笔数。单位：单。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt,COUNT(*) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.infull_order
WHERE order_status=1 AND success_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date<CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 金币房｜点券充值账号数
definition: 按充值日期、充值档位对成功充值订单账号去重；点券全链路数据集的充值行为账号数为成功订单与点券正向流水所涉账号并集去重。 `gold_ods.infull_order`，`order_status=1`、`product_name LIKE '%点券%'`；渠道按 `user_agent_id`。 单位：个。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.infull_order
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (order_status=1 AND product_name LIKE '%点券%')
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 金币房｜桌费
definition: 对真人玩家对局日志的 `num_8` 求和。 与真人用户总盈亏采用同一对局范围。 单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_time) AS dt, SUM(num_8) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log
WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (user_id NOT BETWEEN 2614636 AND 2615635)
GROUP BY DATE(log_time);

name: 金币房｜机器人总盈亏
definition: 机器人玩家对局日志的 `result_money` 求和。 仅全局总行输出，不向产品/渠道行分摊。 单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_time) AS dt, SUM(result_money) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log
WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (user_id BETWEEN 2614636 AND 2615635)
GROUP BY DATE(log_time);

name: 金币房｜真人用户总盈亏
definition: 非机器人玩家对局日志的 `result_money` 求和。 `gold_ods.comm_game_log`；机器人按固定用户范围排除。 单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_time) AS dt, SUM(result_money) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log
WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (user_id NOT BETWEEN 2614636 AND 2615635)
GROUP BY DATE(log_time);

name: 金币房｜点券充值点券流入量
definition: `gold_ods.prop_log` 中 `prop_id=100000`、`data_type=102`、正向 `prop_num` 求和。 点券全链路充值行为；人数与订单数仍由对应明细字段计算。 单位：点券。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.prop_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=100000 AND data_type=102 AND prop_num>0)
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜首充赠送金币
definition: `gold_ods.prop_log` 中 `prop_id=1`、`data_type=102`、正向 `prop_num` 求和；账号按 `user_id` 去重。 作为点券链路的赠金单列；不和 `user_money_log` 镜像重复相加。 单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.prop_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=1 AND data_type=102 AND prop_num>0)
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜七日畅玩套餐点券消耗
definition: `gold_ods.prop_log` 中 `prop_id=100000`、`data_type=453` 的负向点券流水按 `-prop_num` 求和；套餐档位分别扣80、300、980点券。 453扣券与对应金币整包到账按档位配对；到账只取 `user_money_log`。452是每日领取金币，不算当日点券消耗；451为零流水档。 单位：点券。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(-prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.prop_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=100000 AND data_type=453 AND prop_num<0)
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜点券消耗量
definition: gold_ods.prop_log中prop_id=100000、prop_num<0，按log_date归日，SUM(-prop_num)作为正向点券消耗量。本批业务范围data_type为447特惠礼包、448兑换金币、450买道具、453七日畅玩；按data_type筛选。与保留负号的点券变动量、金币到账量分开。单位：点券。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(-prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.prop_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=100000 AND data_type IN (447,448,450,453) AND prop_num<0)
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜七日畅玩金币到账
definition: 套餐整包金币分别为10万、40万、140万；金币侧只取 `user_money_log` 正向到账。 453套餐购买与整包到账配对；452每日领取不并入套餐扣券明细。 单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.user_money_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=1 AND type=453 AND prop_num>0)
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜金币每日免费礼包
definition: `user_money_log` 中 `type=447` 且金币产出为 1500 的记录求和。 1500档为免费；其余447档属于付费金币产出。 单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.user_money_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=1 AND type=447 AND prop_num=1500)
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜非对局金币消耗
definition: `prop_id=1` 且 `prop_num<0` 的金币流水，剔除 `type` 1、6、10 后，对 `-prop_num` 求和。 `gold_ods.user_money_log`；以消耗正数展示。 单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(-prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.user_money_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=1 AND prop_num<0 AND type NOT IN (1,6,10))
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜活动金币产出
definition: `prop_id=1` 的正向金币流水中，`type` 为 454、455、2411、2412、1132、1133、1135、1136 的金额合计。 `gold_ods.user_money_log`；与免费金币产出分开统计，不并入免费产出；同一来源类型不可重复计入两个分类。 单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.user_money_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=1 AND prop_num>0 AND type IN (454,455,2411,2412,1132,1133,1135,1136))
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜免费金币产出
definition: 按gold_ods.user_money_log.log_date统计正向prop_id=1金币流水，沿用免费金币类型排除清单、1100—1127区间排除及447特殊规则。type=447时仅prop_num=1500属于每日免费礼包；447其他正向数量不计免费。可按来源type筛选，不把付费、活动或镜像流水并入免费产出。单位：金币。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt, SUM(prop_num) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.user_money_log
WHERE log_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (prop_id=1 AND prop_num>0 AND type NOT IN (1,6,10,102,125,126,129,134,139,143,149,157,223,235,236,242,997,998,1000,1005,449,451,452,453,2411,2412,454,455,1132,1133,1135,1136) AND type NOT BETWEEN 1100 AND 1127 AND (type<>447 OR prop_num=1500))
GROUP BY DATE(log_date);

name: 金币房｜付费金币产出
definition: 按log_date归日，汇总付费类型的正向金币流水：gold_ods.user_money_log中prop_id=1、prop_num>0，类型为102、125、126、129、134、139、143、149、157、235、236、242、997、998、1000、1005、449、451、452、453，另包括type=447且prop_num不等于1500；再加gold_ods.prop_log中data_type=102、prop_id=1的正向首充赠金。金币侧type=449为点券兑换金币，type=447非1500档为付费特惠礼包；这两个子集通过type筛选复用，不另建产出指标。保留渠道和玩法维度，原子范围及金币单位不变。金币到账只取指定金币流水，不再叠加其他道具镜像。无到账记录不补0，按交易日期轴展示时另铺日期。单位：金币。
sql:
WITH flow AS (
 SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt,type,agent_id,game_id,prop_num AS n FROM gold_ods.user_money_log
 WHERE log_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date<CURRENT_DATE()
 AND prop_id=1 AND prop_num>0 AND (type IN (102,125,126,129,134,139,143,149,157,235,236,242,997,998,1000,1005,449,451,452,453) OR (type=447 AND prop_num<>1500))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT DATE(log_date) AS dt,102 AS type,agent_id,game_id,prop_num AS n FROM gold_ods.prop_log
 WHERE log_date>=DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_date<CURRENT_DATE()
 AND prop_id=1 AND data_type=102 AND prop_num>0
)
SELECT dt,SUM(n) AS metric_value FROM flow GROUP BY dt;

name: 金币房｜比赛活跃账号数
definition: 当日比赛玩法账号去重数，要求 `game_time>0`。 比赛玩法编号为 2070、2012；这是比赛活跃，不并入金币玩法活跃。 单位：个。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_time) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log
WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (game_time>0 AND game_id IN (2070,2012))
GROUP BY DATE(log_time);

name: 金币房｜对局玩家数
definition: gold_ods.comm_game_log按log_time归日，对user_id去重。通用口径不额外限制game_time；比赛口径限定game_time>0且game_id为2070、2012。agent_id=100010123为小程序，其余为标准端。按玩法、端别和渠道筛选；跨玩法合计从明细重新去重。单位：账号。
sql:
SELECT DATE(log_time) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.comm_game_log
WHERE log_time >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND log_time < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (1=1)
GROUP BY DATE(log_time);

name: 金币房｜平台新增账号数
definition: 新增账号按 `user_info.last_platform` 分类后按账号去重；1=安卓、2=苹果端、其他值归其他端。 注册日使用 `reg_date`；此平台维度不替代渠道维度。 单位：个。
sql: SELECT DATE(reg_date) dt,CASE WHEN last_platform=1 THEN '安卓' WHEN last_platform=2 THEN '苹果端' ELSE '其他端' END platform,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM gold_ods.user_info WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE() GROUP BY DATE(reg_date),CASE WHEN last_platform=1 THEN '安卓' WHEN last_platform=2 THEN '苹果端' ELSE '其他端' END;

name: 金币房｜新增设备数
definition: 注册账号在注册当日登录的非空 `mac` 去重数。 `user_info.reg_date` 与 `gold_ods.app_login_log.login_date` 按同一账号关联；仅统计注册当日登录。 单位：个。
sql: SELECT DATE(u.reg_date) dt,COUNT(DISTINCT l.mac) metric_value FROM gold_ods.user_info u JOIN gold_ods.app_login_log l ON l.user_id=u.user_id AND l.login_date>=DATE(u.reg_date) AND l.login_date<DATE_ADD(DATE(u.reg_date),INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE u.reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND u.reg_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND l.mac IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.mac)<>'' GROUP BY DATE(u.reg_date);

name: 金币房｜登录活跃设备数
definition: 按日统计非空 `mac` 去重数。 `gold_ods.app_login_log.login_date`。 单位：个。
sql:
SELECT DATE(login_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT mac) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.app_login_log
WHERE login_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND login_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (mac IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(mac)<>'')
GROUP BY DATE(login_date);

name: 金币房｜苹果端成功充值金额
definition: 成功订单 `order_amount` 求和。 与成功充值金额相同范围，另限 `client_platform=2`。 单位：元。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, SUM(order_amount) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.infull_order
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (order_status=1 AND client_platform=2)
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 金币房｜安卓端成功充值金额
definition: 成功订单 `order_amount` 求和。 与成功充值金额相同范围，另限 `client_platform=1`。 单位：元。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, SUM(order_amount) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.infull_order
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (order_status=1 AND client_platform=1)
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 金币房｜成功充值金额
definition: gold_ods.infull_order成功订单order_status=1，按success_date归日，SUM(order_amount)，单位元，不除以100。订单client_platform=1安卓、2苹果；user_agent_id=100010123为小程序，其余为标准端。点券充值商品以product_name含“点券”筛选。渠道使用订单user_agent_id；客户端、端别、商品属于不同筛选维度。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, SUM(order_amount) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.infull_order
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (order_status=1)
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 金币房｜成功付费账号数
definition: gold_ods.infull_order成功订单order_status=1，按success_date归日，对user_id去重。点券充值范围为product_name含“点券”；按订单user_agent_id与client_platform筛选。跨商品、渠道或客户端合计须从明细重新去重。单位：账号。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.infull_order
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (order_status=1)
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 金币房｜新增账号数
definition: gold_ods.user_info按reg_date归属注册日，对user_id去重，渠道为注册账号agent_id，平台为last_platform，1安卓、2苹果。生命周期注册cohort从2026-01-01起；统计窗口由注册日期范围限定。与注册当日首次参与某玩法的cohort、玩法first_intogame新增分开。单位：账号。
sql:
SELECT DATE(reg_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM gold_ods.user_info
WHERE reg_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND reg_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (1=1)
GROUP BY DATE(reg_date);

name: 好友房｜贵族续费金额
definition: 上述归因成功续费订单的 `infull_amount` 求和后除以100。 按月卡、季卡、年卡及日期分类；同一 `order_no` 仅计一次。 单位：元。
sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.order_no,o.user_id,o.success_date,o.infull_amount,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.order_no ORDER BY e.log_date DESC,e.id DESC) rn FROM friend_ods.pook_infull o JOIN friend_ods.user_vip_info v ON v.user_id=o.user_id AND v.first_buy_time<o.success_date JOIN friend_ods.behavior_log e ON e.user_id=o.user_id AND e.event_id='renewal_btn_click' AND e.log_date<=o.success_date AND e.log_date>=DATE_SUB(o.success_date,INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) WHERE o.success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.success_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND o.infull_state=1 AND o.item_id IN (111,112,254,256)) SELECT DATE(success_date) dt,SUM(infull_amount)/100.0 metric_value FROM matched WHERE rn=1 GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 好友房｜贵族续费账号数
definition: 对已有 `first_buy_time` 且早于成功订单的账号，匹配支付前30分钟内同账号 `renewal_btn_click`；每笔 `order_no` 只保留时间最近、同时间事件 `id` 最大的一条，再按账号去重。 `friend_ods.pook_infull`、`friend_ods.user_vip_info`、`friend_ods.behavior_log`；商品为111、112、254、256。 单位：个。
sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.order_no,o.user_id,o.success_date,o.infull_amount,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.order_no ORDER BY e.log_date DESC,e.id DESC) rn FROM friend_ods.pook_infull o JOIN friend_ods.user_vip_info v ON v.user_id=o.user_id AND v.first_buy_time<o.success_date JOIN friend_ods.behavior_log e ON e.user_id=o.user_id AND e.event_id='renewal_btn_click' AND e.log_date<=o.success_date AND e.log_date>=DATE_SUB(o.success_date,INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) WHERE o.success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.success_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND o.infull_state=1 AND o.item_id IN (111,112,254,256)) SELECT DATE(success_date) dt,COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) metric_value FROM matched WHERE rn=1 GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 好友房｜贵族商品购买金额
definition: 贵族订单 `infull_amount` 求和后除以100，保留两位小数。 贵族明细报表；按 `success_date`、商品分类和购买场景统计。 单位：元。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, ROUND(SUM(infull_amount)/100.0,2) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.pook_infull
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (infull_state=1 AND item_id IN (111,112,254,256))
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 好友房｜贵族商品购买账号数
definition: 贵族成功订单涉及的 `user_id` 去重数；也可按商品分别去重。 同一账号多笔订单在账号数中只计一次。 单位：个。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.pook_infull
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (infull_state=1 AND item_id IN (111,112,254,256))
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 好友房｜贵族商品购买次数
definition: 按成功订单行计数；分别按月卡、季卡、年卡分类。 贵族明细按 `success_date`，商品按上述 `item_id` 映射。 单位：个。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, COUNT(*) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.pook_infull
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (infull_state=1 AND item_id IN (111,112,254,256))
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 好友房｜代理购卡张数
definition: 代理购卡订单的 `buy_num` 求和。 按订单商品和日期统计。 单位：张。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, SUM(buy_num) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.pook_infull
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (infull_state=1 AND item_id IN (1,21,22,23,24,25,26,31,32,1000,10002,10003,10004))
GROUP BY DATE(success_date);

name: 好友房｜官方购卡账号数
definition: 成功官方房卡订单涉及的 `user_id` 去重数。 同官方购卡订单范围。 单位：个。
sql:
SELECT DATE(success_date) AS dt, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS metric_value
FROM friend_ods.pook_infull
WHERE success_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(),INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND success_date < CURRENT_DATE()
  AND (infull_state=1 AND ((success_date>='2026-03-01' AND item_id BETWEEN 201 AND 206) OR (success_date<'2026-03-01' AND item_id IN (11,12,13,14,15,16,34,35,36,114,115))))

name: 好友房｜购卡张数

name: 登录账号第1日回访率
definition: 第0日出现在登录日志的去重账号中，第1个自然日再次出现的比例；是活跃账号回访，不是新注册留存。
sql:
WITH active AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT DATE(`login_date`) AS d, `user_id` AS uid
 FROM `xianmo_ods`.`app_login_log`
 WHERE `login_date` >= '${start_date}'
   AND `login_date` < DATE_ADD('${end_date}', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
   AND `login_date` < '${data_complete_before}'
   AND `user_id` IS NOT NULL
), cohort AS (
 SELECT d, uid FROM active
 WHERE d < DATE('${end_date}')
   AND DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) < DATE('${data_complete_before}')
)
SELECT c.d AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users,
       COUNT(r.uid) AS returned_users,
       1.0 * COUNT(r.uid) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS metric_value
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN active r
 ON c.uid=r.uid AND r.d=DATE_ADD(c.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY c.d;

WITH active AS (

 FROM `bkby_ods`.`app_login_log`

   AND `login_date` < DATE_ADD('${end_date}', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
   AND `login_date` < '${data_complete_before}'
   AND `user_id` IS NOT NULL
), cohort AS (
 SELECT d, uid FROM active
 WHERE d < DATE('${end_date}')
   AND DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) < DATE('${data_complete_before}')
)

name: 破产率
definition: 破产率 = 破产用户数（指标 152）/ SPIN用户数（指标 145）。分子继承破产用户数的当前口径：在 bbs_dwd.dwd_gam_slot_log_rt 中先按 user_id、game_id、spin_times 归并同一局，按 buff11、log_date、log_id 的既定顺序确定结算记录，以归并后的 end_money < bet_money 判定破产，并按 user_id 去重；分母继承 SPIN用户数口径：筛选 game_type = 0 后按 user_id 去重。两者使用相同的 log_date 时间范围及公共维度筛选，先分别聚合再相除；分母为 0 时返回 NULL，跨时间或维度汇总时按总分子/总分母重算。
sql:
'-- 分子继承已发布原子指标 152，分母继承已发布原子指标 145；不固化统计日期。
-- 公共时间及维度筛选必须分别下推到两个源表查询后再聚合；平台自动注入位置尚未验证。
select
    cast(
        (
            select count(distinct user_id)
            from (
                select
                    user_id,
                    game_id,
                    spin_times,
                    max(bet_money) as bet_money,
                    max(case when rn_settle = 1 then end_money end) as end_money
                from (
                    select
                        user_id,
                        game_id,
                        spin_times,
                        bet_money,
                        end_money,
                        row_number() over (
                            partition by user_id, game_id, spin_times
                            order by case when buff11 = 0 then 0 else 1 end, log_date desc, log_id desc
                        ) as rn_settle
                    from bbs_dwd.dwd_gam_slot_log_rt
                ) as spin_detail
                group by
                    user_id,
                    game_id,
                    spin_times
            ) as settled_spin
            where end_money < bet_money
        ) as double
    ) / nullif(
        (
            select count(distinct user_id)
            from bbs_dwd.dwd_gam_slot_log_rt
            where game_type = 0
        ),
        0
    ) as broke_rate;

name: 登录账号第1日回访率
definition: 第0日出现在登录日志的去重账号中，第1个自然日再次出现的比例；是活跃账号回访，不是新注册留存。
sql:
WITH active AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT DATE(`log_date`) AS d, `user_id` AS uid
 FROM `bydsj_ods`.`app_login_log`
 WHERE `log_date` >= '${start_date}'
   AND `log_date` < DATE_ADD('${end_date}', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
   AND `log_date` < '${data_complete_before}'
   AND `user_id` IS NOT NULL
), cohort AS (
 SELECT d, uid FROM active
 WHERE d < DATE('${end_date}')
   AND DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) < DATE('${data_complete_before}')
)
SELECT c.d AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users,
       COUNT(r.uid) AS returned_users,
       1.0 * COUNT(r.uid) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS metric_value
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN active r
 ON c.uid=r.uid AND r.d=DATE_ADD(c.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY c.d;

 CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=1 THEN MAX(reg_user) ELSE NULL END AS metric_value

name: 次日留存率
definition: 以指定注册日bizdate在lydrh5_dwd.dwd_usr_reg_log_hi的去重user_id为注册人群；这些账号在注册日加1日有lydrh5_dwd.dwd_usr_login_log_hi登录记录的去重账号数，除以注册人群账号数。日期轴按注册日解释，日窗口均为左闭右开。只计算已完整结束的回访日；分母为0或观察日未结束时返回NULL。输出0—1比例，展示可格式化为百分数。平台与渠道条件取注册记录，回访按同user_id关联，不要求回访平台/渠道相同；跨日、跨维度从明细重算，不能把活跃账号或设备人群替代注册账号。
sql:
WITH reg_user AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id
  FROM lydrh5_dwd.dwd_usr_reg_log_hi
  WHERE log_date >= DATE('${bizdate}')
    AND log_date < DATE_ADD(DATE('${bizdate}'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
), return_user AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id
  FROM lydrh5_dwd.dwd_usr_login_log_hi
  WHERE log_date >= DATE_ADD(DATE('${bizdate}'), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    AND log_date < DATE_ADD(DATE('${bizdate}'), INTERVAL 2 DAY)
)
SELECT IF(
         DATE_ADD(DATE('${bizdate}'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) < CURRENT_DATE(),
         COUNT(DISTINCT l.user_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_id), 0),
         NULL
       ) AS d1_retention_rate
FROM reg_user r
LEFT JOIN return_user l ON r.user_id = l.user_id;

name: 登录账号第1日回访率
definition: 第0日出现在登录日志的去重账号中，第1个自然日再次出现的比例；是活跃账号回访，不是新注册留存。
sql:
WITH active AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT DATE(`login_date`) AS d, `user_id` AS uid
 FROM `ydxz_ods`.`app_login_log`
 WHERE `login_date` >= '${start_date}'
   AND `login_date` < DATE_ADD('${end_date}', INTERVAL 1 DAY)
   AND `login_date` < '${data_complete_before}'
   AND `user_id` IS NOT NULL
), cohort AS (
 SELECT d, uid FROM active
 WHERE d < DATE('${end_date}')
   AND DATE_ADD(d, INTERVAL 1 DAY) < DATE('${data_complete_before}')
)
SELECT c.d AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users,
       COUNT(r.uid) AS returned_users,
       1.0 * COUNT(r.uid) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS metric_value
FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN active r
 ON c.uid=r.uid AND r.d=DATE_ADD(c.d, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY c.d;
